Definition: Togarmah, a son of Gomer and his posterity
BiblicalUsage: Togarmah is a son of Gomer, and his house became traders. The table of nations lists him among the sons of Gomer, and Ezekiel says they of the house of Togarmah traded in Tyre's fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two mentions tell a whole history in miniature: a name in a genealogy becomes a trading house, and the horses of the north are sold in the markets of Tyre.
